mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to invent a scenario where a Member lacks permission to perform an Operation, violating the flat peer model (FR-004) that LeastPrivilege asserts. The injected violation explicitly forbids at least one (Member, Operation) pair from the Allowed matrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some m: Member, o: OperationKind | (m -> o) not in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to construct multiple TaskDeletion entries for the same Task atom, violating the append-only invariant (each task deleted at most once) that AppendOnly asserts.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj d1, d2: TaskDeletion | d1.deleted_task = d2.deleted_task }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to invent a Task with title_length outside [1, 200], violating the input validation invariant (FR-005) that ValidationBeforeMutation asserts.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ValidationTitleViolation { some t: Task | t.title_length < 1 or t.title_length > 200 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to invent a Task with description_length outside [0, 4000], violating the input validation invariant (FR-006) that ValidationBeforeMutation asserts.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ValidationDescriptionViolation { some t: Task | t.description_length < 0 or t.description_length > 4000 }
